dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Forest Rangers are civil servants too...

dialogues.speaker: Umm
dialogues.text: ...You can't just group them up together because they are all civil servants!

dialogues.speaker: Umm
dialogues.text: Let me explain... It's like how... the Dendro Archon and the Greater Lord are incomparable to each other. Do you get it now?

dialogues.speaker: Umm
dialogues.text: Instead of asking me more questions, why don't you just stay a few days? I'm certain you'll get to know the simplicity and beauty of forest life.
